text: Marrowgate Water Board elected Henrik Dalloway as chair on Monday, replacing interim head Sera Kint after a 6-3 board vote. Dalloway, previously deputy chair and finance lead, said he will prioritize leak reduction and debt trimming. The utility closed the third quarter with revenue up 7.4% to 48.2 million crowns, while operating costs rose 3.1% to 31.6 million. Capital spending is set at 9.8 million for the next six months, mainly for pipe renewal in the East Fen district. Analysts said the appointment signals continuity, but tighter cash management. For the water services sector, it suggests boards are favoring disciplined investment over aggressive expansion.
